provenance_note: Per-decision raw FP32 row verification manifest for the Arm-A reference rows on inferswarm04 (/srv/inferswarm/state/issue117/arm-a/{control,integrated}/reference/cases/<case_id>/decision-<i>.f32), including the per-row summary binding against the on-node arm reference-case summaries. Recovered read-only on 2026-09-08; no execution. The 01-relayed copies of these summaries were byte-checked against the on-node originals during recovery (zero drift), so the binding holds on both nodes.
